claim_ceiling: Linear combinations (equal concat of center_projected_64 + cited_decisions_tfidf) pass both adversarial gates at 19-year scale (122k decisions) with JP=0.545, LangDom=0.767, partially breaking the two-mode tradeoff. This finding is reproduced across independent seeds (v13→v14). However, JuristPref ceiling remains at ~0.54 for stable combinations, cross-lingual transfer remains weak (zero_shot_nmi ~0.2), and citation independence is sacrificed (CiteIndep ~0.31 vs 0.505 for metric-learning baseline). Full 174k dense embeddings blocked by source data gap. Product must expose multiple map modes.
evidence_summary: Verified across 8 primary evidence files: (1) 19-year dense eval (center_projected FAIL both gates: LangDom=0.983/0.860, JP=0.047/0.369); (2) 19-year linear combinations (linear_citation_concat PASS both: LangDom=0.767, JP=0.545; linear_hybrid05_concat PASS both: LangDom=0.778, JP=0.540); (3) 15-year linear combinations baseline (JP=0.481 FAIL); (4) Section cross-lingual (all modes FAIL: sachverhalt invariance_gap=0.187, erwaegungen invariance_gap=0.452); (5) 15-year center-projected combined results (all FAIL adversarial); (6) v14 independent rerun validation JSON (linear_citation_concat mean_delta=+0.0392, paired_std=0.0212 PASS; linear_hybrid05_concat highest JP=0.7925 but paired_std=0.0422 FAIL); (7) v14 report (tradeoff persists, MLP unstable, static concat dominates); (8) legal-distance.json lane state (critical findings consistent). No leakage, gaming, post-hoc metrics, or unsupported claims detected. Negative results honestly reported.
